comment: The curation record behind data/images/ (v2.3, D-051). One entry per
validates every entry, re-verifies the climate zone against the tool's own
bundled Köppen grid, downloads and checksums the original, re-encodes it,
and generates the manifest and attribution document from this file.
The 'verified' notes record what the three D-051.4 verifications actually
found: the licence as read from the file page itself, and what the image
was seen to depict. The zone note is written by the build script, which
refuses any entry whose zone does not reproduce.
